settings.question: How should I care for my Lisandra garments?
settings.answer:
To preserve the beauty and shape of your delicate knit and crochet pieces, follow these care instructions:

  • Hand Wash Only: Gently hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent. Avoid scrubbing or wringing the fabric.
  • Do Not Machine Wash or Tumble Dry: Machine washing or tumble drying can stretch, shrink, or damage the delicate fibers.
  • Lay Flat to Dry: After washing, reshape the garment and lay it flat to air dry. Avoid hanging, as this may cause stretching or misshaping.
  • Store with Care: Always fold rather than hang.

Each Lisandra piece is handmade with care, treat it gently to enjoy it season after season.

settings.question: What currency are Lisandra prices set to?
settings.answer: All prices on Lisandra The Label are listed in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp), regardless of the country you're shopping from. Your credit card will be charged in IDR and then converted to your local currency by your bank on your account statement.

settings.question: What are Lisandra's sustainability practices?
settings.answer:
We are committed to slow fashion, creating timeless, high-quality pieces that are made to last. Each garment is handcrafted in Bali by local artisans, supporting traditional craftsmanship and ethical production. By producing in small, limited batches, we minimize waste and avoid overproduction.

Our materials are carefully selected with sustainability in mind, favoring natural fibers and low-impact processes whenever possible. To reduce our environmental footprint, we use reusable tote bags and biodegradable poly mailers for our packaging.

By choosing Lisandra, you're not only embracing effortless resort elegance, you’re also supporting mindful fashion that values people, the planet, and the art of handmade design.
